div.head: Grið 17
div.ab: 7 beo þæra þreora swylc hit beo (gylde he, þeowige he 7 þolige he), finde borh, gyf he mæge; 7 gyf he ne mæge, þonne swerie he, þæt he æfre ne stele ne feoh ne ætbere ne witnunge ne wrece.
And beo þæra þreora swylc hit beo – gylde he, þeowige he and þolige he – finde borh, gyf he mæge; and gyf he ne mæge, þonne swerie he þæt he æfre ne stele ne feoh ne ætbere ne witnunge ne wrece.

Und von diesen dreien trete welches es sei ein, [nämlich] zahle er, werde er Knecht und [= oder] dulde er [gefangen: jedenfalls] finde er Bürgschaft [künftigen Wohlverhaltens], wenn er kann; und wenn er [das] nicht kann, dann schwöre er, dass er hinfort weder stehlen noch Fahrhabe entwenden, noch Bestrafung rächen werde.

And whichever of these three it may be, [namely] whether he pays, becomes a slave, or [= or] suffers [imprisonment: in any case] let him find surety [for future good conduct] if he can; and if he cannot, then let him swear that he will never again steal, nor carry off goods, nor avenge his punishment.

And whichever of these three it is—whether he pays, serves, or suffers—he is to arrange for security if he can; and if he cannot, then he is to swear that he will never commit robbery nor steal livestock nor avenge his punishment.
